content: We also test on the BioASQ 5b dataset, which consists of question-answer pairs from PubMed abstracts. We use the publicly available system from BIBREF14 , and follow the exact same setup as theirs, focusing only on factoid and list questions. For this setting, there are only 899 questions for training. Since this is already a low-resource problem we only report results using 5-fold cross-validation on all the available data. We report Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) on the factoid questions, and F1 score for the list questions.
